jobs.title: Academic IntegrityDetect and deter cheating before it happens.
jobs.description: LIVE Join our next live Zoom webinar, Thursday, September 24 Register → Detection tells you something looks wrong. Understanding tells you what students actually know. AI made it impossible to tell authorship from a submission alone. Tomax shifts the question from who wrote this to whether the student can explain it, and gives faculty the evidence to stand behind every grade. See how Smart Defense works Trusted by 150+ institutions · 500K+ exams a year · 20+ countries THE SHIFT Why detection alone stopped working Generative AI removed the signal that plagiarism tools were built to read. Institutions are left with accusations they can’t prove and students they can’t fairly assess. Similarity scores lost their meaning AI-written work is original by every measure a text-matching tool can apply. A clean report no longer says the student did the work. Faculty carry the burden of proof Suspicion without evidence puts lecturers in an impossible position, and puts honest students under a cloud they cannot clear. Credentials are what is actually at risk A degree is a claim about what a graduate can do. When that claim goes unverified, the institution's reputation absorbs the cost. TWO WAYS IN Secure the exam. Verify the understanding. Most institutions start with one and add the other. Both run inside the same platform, on the same audit trail. 8 LAYERS Online Exam Proctoring Controls the conditions, layer by layer. Mobile proctoring, 360° room verification, live invigilation, and AI-driven monitoring work alongside screen and camera recording, remote-software and VM detection, and cross-platform lockdown, so the exam environment stays sound from first login to submission. Tomax App 360° room verification Live proctoring AI proctoring Screen & camera recording AI & remote software detection VM blocking Cross-platform lockdown NEW Smart Defense Verifies the person. Students explain their reasoning in their own words, and faculty see whether the understanding behind the submission is real, on coursework as well as exams. Spoken defense Reasoning prompts Faculty review Targeted feedback HOW IT WORKS Three steps, no new grading pass 1 Lecturer adds Smart Defense Enable a defense step on any assignment or exam. No change to how the assessment is written or delivered. 2 Student records defense response The student explains their reasoning in their own words, within the secure Tomax exam environment. 3 Lecturer checks understanding Responses arrive alongside the submission, so faculty confirm genuine understanding and reply with targeted feedback, without extra grading passes. What’s inside the integrity stack Every capability is part of the same assessment platform, so integrity data sits next to the submission it belongs to. Identity verification Confirm the person sitting the exam is the enrolled student, before the first question loads. Secure exam environment Lockdown browser and controlled device conditions on both Mac and Windows, for online high-stakes exams. Live monitoring The Monitor control room surfaces anomalies in real time, so invigilators intervene during the exam rather than weeks later. Smart Defense Students explain their reasoning in their own words, on coursework as well as exams. Question scrambling Randomised versions across online and printed exams, so no two students see the same paper. Full audit trail Every action timestamped and retained, exportable for academic misconduct proceedings. Screen & camera recording Every screen and camera feed is recorded for the duration of the sitting, reviewable alongside the submission. AI & remote software detection Flags AI writing tools, remote-access software, and other unauthorized processes running during the exam. Virtual machine blocking Detects and blocks sittings launched inside a virtual machine, closing a common bypass for lockdown controls. EVIDENCE, NOT ACCUSATION A record that holds up in an academic hearing Integrity cases fail when the evidence is a probability score. Tomax produces a timestamped record of what the student did and said, tied to a verified identity, that faculty and committees can review directly. ✓ Verified identity linked to every submission and defense response ✓ Timestamped session log covering the full exam, not sampled moments ✓ Student's own explanation in their own voice, reviewable by the committee ✓ Exportable case file that meets institutional retention policy “With Tomax VIX we slashed costs, scaled assessments to 32 countries, and deliver results faster – all while meeting every compliance bar.” Amy Simrah Chadney Deputy Head of Registry Services, Arden University 1:01 Common questions Is Smart Defense a replacement for proctoring? − No. Proctoring secures the conditions of an exam; Smart Defense verifies the understanding behind the work. Most institutions run these exams across four or five disconnected tools. The paper has to stay sealed A leak before the sitting invalidates the exam for everyone. Custody of the paper matters as much as the security of the room. The platform has to hold Thousands of candidates start within the same minute. Infrastructure that degrades under that load turns into an appeals process. The result has to be defensible Regulators, external examiners, and students all ask the same question later: can you show exactly what happened? EXAM DAY, END TO END Five stages, one chain of custody Select a stage to see what Tomax handles and which part of the platform does the work. 1. Author 2. Secure 3. Deliver 4. Monitor 5. Tomax treats them as two modalities of one process rather than two separate systems, so policy, question banks, and reporting carry across. TomaEtest: Online high-stakes exams Build, deliver, run, and grade secure online exams, end to end. Assessment Studio for authoring, the Monitor control room for exam day, and the Vix client students sit the exam on. Offline resilience Answers are held locally and reconciled on reconnect, so a dropped network is not a lost exam. Chain of custody Every action on the paper is timestamped and attributable, from authoring to release of results. Accessibility built in Screen reader support, adjustable typography, and per-student accommodations as standard. LMS and SIS integration Native connections to Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, and Brightspace, plus API and SAML SSO. jobs.title: Formative AssessmentContinuous checks that guide learning in real time.
jobs.description: LIVE Join our next live Zoom webinar, Thursday, September 24 Register → SOLUTION · FORMATIVE ASSESSMENT Assessment that teaches, not just measures. Lecturers build their own quizzes, activities, and checkpoints in minutes: no admin ticket, no IT request. Students get feedback while the material is still in front of them. See the feedback loop Built for lecturers, not administrators Works inside your LMS THE GAP By the final exam, it is too late to teach Summative results tell you what a cohort failed to learn after the course has ended. The checks that would have caught it earlier are usually the first thing a busy lecturer drops. Setup cost kills the habit If a mid-term check needs an admin request and a scheduling slot, it does not get run. The tooling has to fit inside a lecturer's week. Feedback arrives after it matters A grade returned three weeks later is a verdict. The same comment returned on Thursday is teaching. Nobody sees the cohort drifting Without regular low-stakes signal, a misunderstood concept stays invisible until it shows up in the final results. THE LOOP Build, run, read, adjust, all inside one week 1 Build in minutes Pick question types, pull from your bank, set it live. No admin, no ticket, no training session. 2 Students take it Delivered in the LMS or in Tomax, on any device, with as many attempts as the lecturer allows. 3 Feedback returns immediately Objective items mark themselves and explanations appear while the material is still fresh. 4 Teaching adjusts Cohort analytics show which concept to revisit before the next session, not after the exam. ASSESSMENT STUDIO The lecturer owns the assessment Formative assessment only happens if the person teaching the course can set one up between lectures. Assessment Studio is built for that: no admin involvement, no scheduling request, no training course. Set up a quiz or activity in minutes, without an admin request Every question type, including essay, file upload, and coding Pull from personal or institutional banks in TomaBank Reuse the same items later in a summative paper What lecturers actually build Low-stakes by design. Each one takes minutes to set up and returns something the lecturer can act on before the next session. Pre-lecture readiness checks A short set of questions before class shows who did the reading and where to start the session. Weekly concept quizzes Low-stakes, auto-marked, repeatable: the routine signal that makes drift visible early. Practice papers Past-paper conditions without the stakes, so students calibrate before the real sitting. Self-assessment with rubrics Students mark their own work against the rubric the lecturer will use, then compare. Peer review activities Structured review of each other's submissions, anonymised and moderated. Reflection and defense prompts Students explain their reasoning in their own words, the same mechanic as Smart Defense. WHAT THE DATA IS FOR Analytics that change next Tuesday's lecture Results come back as teaching signal, not a dashboard to admire. Which concept the cohort missed, which students are drifting, which question was badly written. Concept-level breakdown See which topic the cohort missed, not just the average score. Early-warning signals Students trending down surface before the final exam. Item analysis Spot the question that was ambiguous rather than hard. Progress over time Track the same cohort across the whole term, quiz to exam. The same platform as the exam that ends the course Questions written for a Tuesday quiz go into TomaBank and come back out in the final paper. Nothing is rebuilt, and nothing is thrown away. High-Stakes Exams The same question banks and policy carry into secure summative sittings, online or on paper. jobs.title: Grading & FeedbackFaster, fairer grading with AI-assisted feedback.
jobs.description: LIVE Join our next live Zoom webinar, Thursday, September 24 Register → SOLUTION · GRADING & FEEDBACK Spend the marking week on the feedback, not the paperwork. TomaGrade removes the sorting, tallying, and transcribing from marking (online submissions and scanned paper alike), so what is left is the judgement only a marker can make. See the marking flow Online and printed exams Anonymous marking as standard Sold standalone or with the platform WHERE THE TIME GOES Most of marking is not marking Collating scripts, deciphering handwriting, keeping a team consistent, copying marks into a spreadsheet, then into the LMS. The academic judgement is a fraction of the hours. Handling before judgement Collating scripts, matching them to students, distributing them across a team, and collecting them back is work no academic was hired to do. Consistency is manual Keeping a dozen markers to one standard usually means meetings, sampling, and hope. Divergence surfaces after results are out. Transcription costs and risks Marks copied from script to spreadsheet to LMS take hours and introduce the errors that appeals are built on. THE MARKING FLOW From closed sitting to published result Select a step to see what TomaGrade handles for you. 1 Collect 2 Auto-mark 3 Mark 4 Moderate 5 Release Collect every script Online submissions land automatically. Paper scripts are scanned in bulk and matched to the right student and the right scrambled version. Markers do not switch tools between modalities. Online submissions Marked the moment the sitting closes. Objective items score themselves. Written answers go straight into the annotation view with the rubric alongside, ready to distribute across a marking team. Scanned paper scripts Scan the pile once, mark on screen. Scripts are matched to students automatically, scrambled Mix versions are reconciled to the right answer key, and the physical papers never need to be sorted or posted between markers. BUILT FOR EVERY QUESTION TYPE If a lecturer can write it, TomaGrade can mark it From single-line multiple choice to multi-step STEM derivations, every format lands in the same marking view. Nothing gets flattened to plain text and loses its meaning. Objective & multiple choice MCQ, true/false, matching, and numeric-answer items score themselves the moment a sitting closes. Formulas & STEM notation Equations, chemical notation, and multi-step working render exactly as written, so markers see real mathematics, not flattened text. Essay & long-form answers Full annotation tools for extended written responses, online or scanned from paper. File uploads & diagrams Hand-drawn diagrams, spreadsheets, and other attached files sit alongside the rubric, not in a separate download. Coding questions Code submissions keep their formatting and syntax highlighting in the marking view. Non-standard formats Question types that don't fit a standard box can be configured per assessment rather than forced into a generic template. FAIRNESS AT SCALE Twelve markers, one standard The hardest part of marking a large cohort is not speed, it is consistency. Tomax makes divergence visible while there is still time to correct it. Question-based marking One marker takes one question across the cohort, so the standard holds. Blind second marking Independent marks compared and reconciled before release. Live divergence view See where a marker is drifting from the team while marking is still open. Anonymous by default Markers see the script, not the name, unless policy says otherwise. What the student receives A mark on its own teaches nothing. The time saved on administration is what makes real feedback affordable. Annotated script The marked paper itself, with comments in place rather than a summary at the end. Rubric transparency Which criterion earned which mark, so the grade is explainable without an email thread. Faster turnaround Feedback lands while the material is still current, not at the end of the following term. Consistent voice A shared comment bank means the same issue gets the same guidance across the cohort. A route to appeal Every mark is traceable to a marker and a criterion, which resolves most queries before they escalate. Results in the LMS Grades and feedback appear where students already look, with no re-entry by staff. 1:01 “Tomax freed us from the worldwide paper-exam headache. Nobody owns the whole record When integrity data, scripts, and grades live in three systems, assembling the evidence for an appeal becomes an archaeology project. Policy cannot be enforced Rules written centrally are applied differently by each tool, so what is guaranteed on paper is optional in practice.
